prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity DESKTOP WEBSITE DESIGN COMP, landscape 1536x1024, for the Portuguese public portal Bahia do Sul, presenting a territorial proposal and Professor Guilherme. Not a poster: visible website navigation, content sections, buttons, links, and next-section content. Reference 1 is the existing logo: preserve identity and use compactly on a white header. Reference 2 contains the authentic portrait of Professor Guilherme: use ONLY that same man's portrait in a rectangular editorial photo; preserve face, age, gray hair, dark green polo; no invented person or added gestures. Reference 2's layout must NOT be copied. Fixed palette navy #052957, forest #14752b, ocean #0074ad, white, restrained gold #ffb511. Editorial serif headings and clear sans body. Real text only: 'Bahia do Sul', 'Nossa terra. Mais futuro.', 'Conheça o projeto', 'Explore o território', 'Professor Guilherme', 'Conheça sua relação com o projeto', 'Conhecer Guilherme', 'Acompanhar no Instagram', 'Entenda o projeto'. Main nav: 'O projeto', 'Território', 'Professor Guilherme', 'Participar'. No invented statistics, quotes, endorsements, official seals, vote counts or titles of elected office. Landscape imagery illustrates Atlantic rainforest, cacao and southern Bahia coast, not a claim of an exact photographed location. Keep all text readable and restrained, buttons large. Composition: a regional reportage MAGAZINE WEBSITE. White editorial masthead 100px. Main opening uses a strong asymmetrical 8/4 column grid within ample margins: LEFT two-thirds large navy headline 'Bahia do Sul', short subtitle and landscape photograph below; RIGHT one-third a prominent rectangular authentic Professor Guilherme portrait with his name, relation-to-project text, and green 'Conhecer Guilherme' button, all visible alongside the project in the first viewport. No landscape behind portrait; no giant banner. Thin ocean-blue editorial rules and small section labels. At lower quarter, a horizontal split section with 'Explore o território' heading, municipality-search field and contextual illustration of the region (schematic explicitly marked 'Esboço visual'). Followed by a restrained Instagram action. White space and decisive photograph sizes; no nested cards. Distinct editorial columns preserve project primacy while making the person easily discoverable.
